column1: # [OPUS-4.8] SP2Bench per-commit expected result sizes (count mode = solution count).
# Differential check: at the FIXED 250k-triple corpus (bench/sp2b/gen.sh 250000), each
# query's solution count is deterministic, so a row-count drift = a correctness regression.
# Format: <query>\t<rows>. Wired into scripts/ci-bench.sh (sp2b hook) as a hard equality
# check on count mode. Heavy-tier queries (q05a/q06/q12a) live in queries-heavy/ and are
# checked in the EC2/nightly tier, not here.
# ASK queries report 1 (true) / 0 (false) in count mode: q12b=true(1), q12c=false(0).
